purpose: Attach normal hero JobLevel advancement materials from the pinned UnityDataTool parsed ConfigData snapshot without introducing inferred identity or relation edges.
normalizationRules: Preserve hero, JobConnection, JobLevel and Materials source order.
Resolve JobLevel only by explicit numeric ID equality.
Resolve JobMaterial only when GoodsType is exactly 5 and only by explicit numeric ID equality.
Do not join by names, numeric ranges, ID arithmetic, filename similarity, UI order, or historical output.
Do not synthesize a material when ConfigDataJobLevelInfo.Materials is absent or empty.
Fail closed on malformed Goods records, duplicate source IDs, unresolved JobLevel IDs, unresolved JobMaterial IDs, or unsupported GoodsType values in canonical hero JobLevels.
Preserve source GoodsType, Id and Count alongside the resolved JobMaterial snapshot.

PASS: The canonical hero set exactly matches hero-job-links.
Every referenced JobLevel resolves exactly once.
Every canonical JobLevel material record has GoodsType 5 with positive integer Id and Count.
Every referenced JobMaterial resolves exactly once.
Generated ordering and resolved snapshots exactly match the pinned source records.
FAIL: Any upstream, source identity, cardinality, ordering, GoodsType, count, or snapshot mismatch occurs.

completionRule: Run the producer against the current pinned ConfigData source-pack, then run the independent validator. Completion requires generated status PASS, summary status PASS, validator PASS, no hard errors, and no unexpected repository mutation.
